issues.legal_issue: Land acquisition proceedings covered by an award must be quashed where the landowner has not been dispossessed and a prior decision quashed proceedings under the same acquisition notification in a possession-retained situation.
material_facts: An award had been passed in respect of the land.
The landowner had not been dispossessed and still retained possession.
A prior Supreme Court decision quashed proceedings under the same acquisition notification where possession remained with the owners.
issues.conclusion: The landowner was entitled to protection under Section 24(2) of the 2013 Act, and the acquisition proceedings concerning the land were quashed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 provided the protection applied. The Court relied on Karnail Kaur & Ors. v. State of Punjab & Ors., which quashed proceedings under the same acquisition notification where the owners retained possession.

rule.if: land_acquisition_case and award_passed and owner_retains_possession and prior_decision_quashed_same_notification_in_retained_possession_case

predicates.land_acquisition_case: The proceeding concerns the acquisition of land.
predicates.award_passed: An award was made in respect of the land.
predicates.owner_retains_possession: The landowner has not been dispossessed and continues to retain possession.
predicates.prior_decision_quashed_same_notification: A prior court decision quashed proceedings under the same acquisition notification in a case where the owners retained possession.

issues.definition: When a land-acquisition case involves an award, the owner retains possession, and a prior decision quashed proceedings under the same notification in a retained-possession case, the acquisition proceedings are quashed.
